Message:
The Duke with the staff asked me
to watch over Fia...

saying that if I did,
my wish would be granted too.

It’s not like I’d be able
to do anything
if something happened to her...
But, since he asked,
I guess it’s my
ghostly duty to oblige.

In order to return the flower
back to normal,
Fia went to a witch
who was said to be able to
breathe life into anything.

The witch she visited, Yubera,
only had a few days left at most...

as her power was out of control,
slowly destroying her body.

Despite that, the girl
kept using her power,

whittling away what
remained of her life.

Turning her life essence into light,
all to keep painting
a city long destroyed.

Even if her actions made
no sense to anyone else,
we understood...

Her behavior was
far from irrational.
If she couldn’t finish that painting,
she wouldn’t be able to
live with herself.

Just like the two of us, that girl...
was suffocating under
her own guilt...
